tools.name: resolve_listing
tools.description: Identify a Kingdom Hearts, Demon Slayer and One Piece item from a marketplace listing (Mercari, Yahoo! Auctions, Suruga-ya, Mandarake, eBay…). Paste the listing title as-is (Japanese or English), e.g. {title: "一番くじ キングダムハーツ A賞 ソラ フィギュア 箱なし", price_jpy: 4500}. Returns candidates[] (sku_id, name_en, c

tools.name: resolve_listings_batch
tools.description: Run resolve_listing on up to 5 listings in one call, e.g. when comparing search results from a marketplace. Example: {listings: [{title: "…", price_jpy: 3000}, {title: "…"}]}. Returns an array in the same order; each element has the same shape as a resolve_listing result (or {error} for that one lis

tools.name: explain_product
tools.description: Get the full record for one catalog item (Kingdom Hearts, Demon Slayer and One Piece). Pass a sku_id from discover/resolve_listing (e.g. {sku_id: "ichiban-kuji-kh-2018-a"}), or a free-text query such as {query: "Sora Bring Arts Halloween Town"} to get the best match. Returns names (en/ja), product l

tools.name: discover
tools.description: Browse the merchandise catalog of one series (Kingdom Hearts, Demon Slayer and One Piece) by character, budget and purpose. Use it to answer "what merch exists for X?" or "gift ideas under ¥5,000". Example: {ip: "kingdom-hearts", character: "Sora", budget_jpy: 5000, purpose: "display"}. Returns item

tools.name: estimate_landed_cost
tools.description: Estimate the total cost of buying an item in Japan and having it forwarded abroad. Example: {price_jpy: 4500, sku_id: "ichiban-kuji-kh-2018-a", dest_country: "US"}. Returns routes[] (forwarding service × shipping method, with fees and total_jpy, cheapest first) and cheapest. Rough figures only: fee
